fields.label: Your name or business
fields.help: Shown at the top of the booking page, like Anna de Vries or Studio Noord.

fields.label: Taking bookings
fields.help: Off: the page shows the types but takes no bookings.

fields.label: When you can be booked
fields.help: Days and times, like: mon-fri 09:00-17:00, sat 10:00-12:00.

fields.label: Notice, in hours
fields.help: How far ahead a booking must at least be. 2 by default.

fields.label: Days ahead
fields.help: How far ahead people can book. 30 by default.

fields.label: Start times every ... minutes
fields.help: 30: slots start on the hour and half hour.

fields.label: Minutes between appointments
fields.help: Kept free before and after every appointment. 0 by default.

fields.label: Your own video link
fields.help: Your Zoom, Teams or Meet room. Empty: every video call gets its own room on meet.jit.si, which needs no account.

fields.label: Contact e-mail
fields.help: Shown to guests, for questions and changes.
